name: Warning
body:
School divination; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a bell)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute/level

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell you gain a +3 bonus to Perception checks as you gain a preternatural sense of imminent danger. In addition you also gain Uncanny Dodge as the Rogue class feature of the same name.
